args.title: Handle quoted column names in CSV header
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Change parseStatement to correctly process CSV header lines with quoted column names, so that column names in double quotes are stripped of the quotes before comparison and validation. This will fix the failure on files where the header line includes quoted column names, such as "date","amount","description".

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is caused because the parser expects unquoted column names in the CSV header line. Files with quoted column names (e.g., "date","amount","description") cause the row shape assertion to fail. The file src/ingest/parser.ts is responsible since it processes the CSV header line and checks column counts. A fix involves updating this file to handle quoted column names in the header correctly.
